alphabet: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: source alphabet sheet for a real custom display font, not a poster or app mockup. Draw ORIGINAL uppercase lettering with the unmistakable restless hand-lettered feeling of Andrea Pazienza's Pentothal narration and early Frigidaire headings: tall slightly narrow handwritten block capitals, angular but human, subtly irregular proportions, lively tiny slab terminals, fine-to-medium variable black pen strokes. NOT a brush-script font, NOT Permanent Marker, not rounded modern comic lettering, not graffiti, not italic superhero letters. Every letter must be easy to identify. Solid black ink on pure white, sharp edges, no paper grain, no shadows, no decoration, no title, no frame, no labels. Strict specimen layout: exactly 9 equal columns and 4 equal rows on a landscape 1536 by 1024 white canvas. Each cell contains EXACTLY ONE isolated glyph centered with wide empty margins, no cells or lines drawn. All glyphs are similar height and sit on matching row baselines. Row 1 left to right: A B C D E F G H I. Row 2: J K L M N O P Q R. Row 3: S T U V W X Y Z 0. Row 4: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9. Those 36 glyphs only, no duplicates or omissions. Keep ample separation so each character can be extracted into a font. Original alphabet rather than copying a published masthead. Visible human ink personality, condensed but not compressed into illegibility.

illustrations.common: Use case: illustration-story.
